title: SuperBOptimized
description: A clean, lightweight performance foundation designed to boost FPS while remaining a perfect, bloat free template for your own custom modpacks.
body:
# **SBO'zed** #
![FPS Comparison between Vanilla minecraft and SBO'zed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80cc9a90eb9fe2587c953df2f8cd9de13a9d6008_0.webp)
SBO'zed is a performance-focused foundation for Minecraft. It provides a stable, consistent baseline for players who want to maximize frame rates and eliminate micro-stutters, all while keeping the game feeling like a clean, vanilla-plus experience.

**Why use SBO'zed?**

Instead of manually searching for and configuring individual performance mods, SBO'zed offers a pre-tuned, reliable setup. It is designed for anyone who wants a smoother gaming experience without adding unnecessary content, complex UI changes, or hidden background processes.

**Core Features**

- **Engine Optimization:** Integrates essential, high-efficiency mods specifically chosen to stabilize your frame-times. This keeps your 1% lows high, resulting in a much smoother feel during gameplay.

- **Lean and Efficient:** Contains only the necessary components to improve performance. By avoiding excess additions, the pack remains lightweight and highly compatible with your favorite content mods.

- **Simple Foundation:** A modular design that serves as an ideal starting point. You can easily add your own mods on top, knowing that the performance layer is already handled.

**Purpose**

This project is intended for players who need a reliable, high-performance base that they can trust. Whether you are looking to boost your FPS on an older system or want a rock-solid foundation to build your own personal modpack, SBO'zed provides the stability you need to focus on playing the game.
